# Wolf Armor

# Introduction

Wolf Armor is a Mountain-tier armor. This set is the tier above Iron Armor and Root Set, and is replaced by Padded Armor and Vilebone Set, respectively.

## Armor pieces

## Notes

• The Wolf Set's horns protrude backwards instead on the sides, as with stereotypical Viking helmets popularized by the 1876 rendition of Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen.
• Frost resist does not stack with Frost resistance mead, Yagluth power or other armor pieces.
• Frost resist will override the frost weakness from being Wet.
• Frost resist prevents Cold and Freezing effect.
